ModMetaData.name: CE Fix: IsHunkering NRE
ModMetaData.author: Meidocho (local patch)
ModMetaData.description: Fixes two CE combat bugs: 1) NRE in CompSuppressable.IsHunkering when pawn.CurJob is null during suppression recovery. 2) TendSelf/TendPatient reservation conflict red errors (LogCouldNotReserveError spam in battle). See docs/ce_fix_ishunkering_nre.md for details.
